questions.question: When David sang to the LORD after being delivered from Saul and all his enemies, how did he begin the song?

answers.text: He told the LORD he loved Him
He asked the LORD why He waited
He listed his enemies by name

questions.question: When death and chaos overwhelmed David in his song of rescue, what did he do in his distress?

answers.text: He called on the LORD for help
He tried to break free alone
He gave up and stayed silent

questions.question: In David's song of thanks, what did the LORD do for David when He reached down from on high?

answers.text: Drew him out of deep waters
Led him up a high mountain
Carried him out of a burning city

questions.question: In David's song, he said that when his enemies cried to the LORD for help, the LORD answered them. True or false?
